Definition: Joseph, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Joseph = "Jehovah has added"; 1) the eldest son of Jacob by Rachel; 2) father of Igal, who represented the tribe of Issachar among the spies; 3) a son of Asaph; 4) a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 5) a priest of the family of Shebaniah in the time of Nehemiah
